purpose: Non-admission discovery of authoritative upstream event, warning, humanitarian-response and meteorological sources used by World Monitor-like repositories; software aggregators are evidence pointers rather than source admission.

entries.name: GLIDE global disaster identifier catalogue
entries.provider: Asian Disaster Reduction Centre / GLIDE partners
entries.spatial_scope: global
entries.temporal_scope: historical and ongoing records; registration and completeness vary
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Global disaster numbers, country, disaster type, onset dates and linked reports
entries.note: Found through MapAction disaster-impact. GLIDE explicitly discourages secondary statistical analysis of its database; use identifiers to reconcile events, not as an independent loss or frequency estimate. Resolve variant dates, multi-country events, missing and duplicate IDs.

entries.name: IDMC Internal Displacement Updates (IDU)
entries.spatial_scope: global, event and country dependent
entries.temporal_scope: provisional latest 180 days; daily updates, historical GIDD separate
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Event-linked displacement estimates and disaster type with selected geospatial downloads
entries.note: Found through MapAction disaster-impact. IDU is a provisional count of internal movements, not unique people, building damage or insured losses. Preserve event window, source, estimate vintage and subsequent GIDD revisions; inspect API authentication and terms separately.

entries.name: UN CERF grants and project data API
entries.provider: UN OCHA Central Emergency Response Fund
entries.spatial_scope: global countries receiving CERF allocations
entries.temporal_scope: historical and current allocations and project records
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Application, project, country, year, sector and allocation metadata
entries.note: MapAction disaster-impact treats CERF as an event-related source. Financial allocations indicate humanitarian response, not gross catastrophe damage or insured claims; funding timing, emergency classification, code and overlaps with IFRC must be preserved.

entries.name: IFRC GO Disaster Response Emergency Fund appeals API
entries.provider: International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies
entries.spatial_scope: global where Red Cross/Red Crescent appeals operate
entries.temporal_scope: operational and historical appeal/event records; completeness varies
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Appeal code, event link, country, start/end, appeal type, amounts requested/funded and beneficiaries
entries.note: MapAction disaster-impact lists IFRC-DREF. GO appeal atype=0 denotes DREF; event associations may be absent and reported beneficiaries are not insured loss. GO upstream data rights may be unstated; review API conditions and field-level semantics before any persistent import.

entries.name: International Charter Space and Major Disasters activations
entries.provider: International Charter Space and Major Disasters
entries.spatial_scope: global activations; selective coverage
entries.temporal_scope: public activation archive from 2000 onward
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Activation ID/date, disaster type, country, links to imagery and event-specific derived mapping products
entries.note: Found through MapAction disaster-impact. Activation is an observation/response selection signal, not an exhaustive event inventory. Map/imagery products have individual rights, footprints and confidence; do not conflate an activation with an observed damage polygon.

entries.name: Nepal BIPAD disaster, flood-gauge and incident APIs
entries.provider: Government of Nepal / NDRRMA BIPAD portal
entries.spatial_scope: Nepal
entries.temporal_scope: operational and historic portal holdings; endpoint-dependent
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Events, alerts, river/rain stations, hazard layers and selected impact records by administrative geography
entries.note: Discovered from Ancoda Atlas. Public API documentation lists event, flood-station, rain-stations, incident and geohazard GeoJSON endpoints; some schemas include household or individual data and must be excluded. Require per-endpoint auth, provider rights and sensitive-data review before use.

entries.name: Environment Agency real-time flood monitoring API
entries.spatial_scope: England; specific forecast documents may have broader coverage
entries.temporal_scope: operational latest readings and current warnings; typical reading archive approx. four weeks with separate daily CSV archives
entries.resolution_or_granularity: River stage/flow station observations, timestamps, flood warnings and warning-area geometries
entries.note: Discovered from Emergency Centre. API documentation states public OGL open data and 15-minute service cycles but individual station upload cadence varies. Warning areas are not measured inundation and latest readings are not a complete archive. Capture unit, station datum, time and warning lifecycle.

entries.name: Met Office National Severe Weather Warnings Service API
entries.spatial_scope: United Kingdom
entries.temporal_scope: operational issued/updated warnings; provider states no historical warnings archive
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Atom feed of issued warnings, issue/change timestamps, MultiPolygon warning areas, impact likelihood and severity
entries.note: Discovered from Emergency Centre. Met Office documents Atom as the live source of truth and no historical warning API. Need capture issued/updated/cancelled lifecycle while monitoring. Polygon means forecast warning area, never an observed physical wind/flood footprint.

entries.name: Open-Meteo multi-model forecast and archived single-runs APIs
entries.provider: Open-Meteo GmbH (redistributor of national weather model output)
entries.spatial_scope: global with regional native model subsets
entries.temporal_scope: live forecasts; original-run archives depend on model and release, with IFS from 2024 and many models from April 2026
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Point forecasts, selected model run/init/lead hour, model-specific spatial resolution and interpolated time series
entries.note: Discovered from Crisis Compass and Ancoda Atlas. The Open-Meteo APIs aggregate DWD ICON, ECMWF IFS, Météo-France ARPEGE, CMA GRAPES and other model outputs. Avoid double counting their upstream model sources as independent observations; record provider, exact model/run, interpolation, forecast lead time and commercial access terms.

entries.name: BMKG Indonesia open earthquake event feed
entries.spatial_scope: Indonesia and surrounding earthquake region
entries.temporal_scope: recent earthquake snapshots updated on occurrence; separate reviewed historical repository
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Recent and felt event JSON/XML with magnitude, depth, time, coordinates and ShakeMap image reference
entries.note: Discovered in GlobeWatch. BMKG documents recent earthquake event products, seven current files and mandatory attribution, with 60 requests/minute/IP. Its public feed is a recent rolling snapshot, not complete historic seismicity. For history use the separately documented BMKG repository with authentication/rights review; preserve agency IDs and preliminary-to-reviewed revisions.

entries.name: Japan Meteorological Agency earthquake and volcano high-frequency XML feed
entries.spatial_scope: Japan and neighboring earthquake/volcano advisory domains
entries.temporal_scope: operational minute-updated feed carrying the most recent bulletins
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Official XML bulletin references for recent earthquake and volcanic information
entries.note: Discovered from GlobeWatch; Japanese e-Gov data portal registers JMA eqvol.xml and Japanese Government Standard Terms of Use. Fast operational feed retains recent bulletins only, not a complete historical catalogue. Preserve native event/issue IDs, bulletin type, revisions and official original XML semantics.

entries.name: NASA Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS) temporal satellite visualizations
entries.spatial_scope: global, selected product coverage and map projection
entries.temporal_scope: time-varying NASA satellite visualization products; product-dependent archive
entries.resolution_or_granularity: WMS, WMTS, TMS and XYZ map tiles with product-specific resolutions and timestamps
entries.note: Discovered in Terra Watch. GIBS serves imagery visualizations; a colored map tile or corrected reflectance is not directly a damage mask, flood depth or numeric hazard. For quantitative CAT use identify and obtain original instrument/product values, version, cloud quality, time, projection, resampling and rights separately.

entries.name: WFP ADAM OGC global disaster impact and alert layers
entries.spatial_scope: global event coverage dependent on module
entries.temporal_scope: near-real-time; public API layers with model-dependent event history
entries.resolution_or_granularity: OGC API Features/GeoJSON and vector tiles; hazard and estimated population/cropland/infrastructure impacts
entries.note: MapAction disaster-impact described old WFP ADAM scraping as blocked; the current provider developer docs describe a public no-auth OGC API. This is an apparent access evolution, not a successful endpoint probe. ADAM derives from GDACS, USGS ShakeMap, GloFAS, FloodScan and other inputs: outputs are NOT independent ground truth or insured damages; preserve collection, event, timestamp and lineage.

entries.name: JMA RSMC Tokyo historical tropical cyclone best track
entries.spatial_scope: western North Pacific and South China Sea per RSMC Tokyo area
entries.temporal_scope: historic best-track text archive from 1951 through 2026 with published revisions
entries.resolution_or_granularity: storm identifier, time, center coordinates, central pressure, wind metrics and categorical intensities
entries.note: Discovered from World Monitor western Pacific cyclones and Crisis Compass JMA-model context. Historic best track is a retrospective agency analysis, unlike operational advisory and forecast tracks. Preserve issue/revision history, UTC convention, unit conversion and basin; tracks are not a wind-speed footprint.

entries.name: NOAA NTWC/PTWC official tsunami warning Atom feeds
entries.provider: NOAA National Weather Service U.S. Tsunami Warning Centers
entries.spatial_scope: NTWC continental US/Alaska/Canada; PTWC Hawaii, US Pacific and Caribbean territories plus international advisories
entries.temporal_scope: current operational notices and product update stream; archive/retention unknown
entries.resolution_or_granularity: NTWC PAAQAtom.xml and PTWC PHEBAtom.xml entries with product identifiers and issue time
entries.note: Source code in GlobeWatch uses both Atom URLs; NOAA officially lists both. Message regions do not prove inundation, wave height at any location or physical damage; combine with NOAA tsunami historical and coastal observations already in OpenCatastrophe only after model/data independence review.

entries.name: USGS Volcano Hazards Program HANS notices and VONA API
entries.provider: United States Geological Survey Volcano Hazards Program
entries.spatial_scope: US volcanoes monitored by USGS observatories, notice-specific
entries.temporal_scope: current and selected historical notices; provider warns endpoint stability is not guaranteed
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Volcano IDs, alert levels, timestamps, VONA aviation notices, observatory and CAP alert metadata
entries.note: WorldMirror lists USGS volcano notices. Official USGS HANS API returns current alerts for elevated volcanoes, monitored volcano status and individual notices. An alert level is not an ash plume, depth or loss footprint. Preserve notice lifecycle and provider service-version availability.

entries.name: GDELT 2.0 Event database and associated mentions
entries.spatial_scope: global multilingual news where monitored publishers cover events
entries.temporal_scope: machine-updated 15-minute global event/mentions stream with heterogeneous historic coverage
entries.resolution_or_granularity: CAMEO event and article mention tables; approximate geo references, textual themes and media attention
entries.note: Found in World Monitor, GlobeWatch, Terra Watch, WorldMirror and FIRESTORM. Multiple dashboards reading GDELT are one underlying source; never count articles as independent perils or insured loss. Media attention, language, geocoding and event type create systematic bias. GEO 2.0 query endpoint should not be assumed operational from older repo code.

entries.name: Cloudflare Radar internet outage and anomaly API
entries.spatial_scope: global countries and AS networks with Cloudflare signal coverage
entries.temporal_scope: time-bounded current and historic annotations; provider API specific history
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Start/end outage timestamps, affected geographies, ASNs, descriptions and outage cause
entries.note: Found in World Monitor infrastructure monitor. Cloudflare states Radar API material is CC BY-NC 4.0; insurance/commercial usage requires separate rights clearance. Geographic coverage and inferred causes can be incomplete. A network outage does not directly measure physical facility damage or insured business interruption.

entries.name: Epoch AI global data-center locations and power estimates
entries.spatial_scope: largest AI compute data centers worldwide; knowingly incomplete
entries.temporal_scope: revised downloadable dataset with changeable coverage and site records
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Site location, build phase, modelled electricity capacity, facility attributes and estimated hardware
entries.note: World Monitor mentions Epoch data centers. Provider supplies CSV/ZIP and CC-BY attribution, but sources are satellite/permits and estimates, not insured values or exhaustive datacenter stock. Freeze exact release, status, lat/lon precision, observed vs estimated variables and attribution.

entries.name: Fintraffic Digitraffic marine AIS, port call, sea-state and ice navigation API
entries.spatial_scope: Finnish maritime region; vessel routes and call data as covered by Finland feeds
entries.temporal_scope: frequently updated observational/operational services; historical retention varies
entries.resolution_or_granularity: AIS location GeoJSON/JSON, vessel and port-call metadata, buoy sea state, winter navigation and AtoN faults
entries.note: GlobeWatch code calls meri.digitraffic.fi AIS endpoints. Official Digitraffic docs show port calls, sea state and winter navigation as extra datasets. Geographic coverage is NOT global; ship position and AIS visibility are not complete ship exposure or insured cargo values.

entries.name: InciWeb / NIFC official wildfire incident updates
entries.provider: National Interagency Fire Center and participating incident management teams
entries.spatial_scope: United States reported major incidents and participating response teams
entries.temporal_scope: operational incident reports and maps; updates vary by incident and archive policy
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Incident names, agency updates, containment, affected community and linked maps
entries.note: FIRESTORM consumes InciWeb RSS. NIFC identifies InciWeb as current incident-specific information, but an openly documented, stable public machine API has not been confirmed. Manual discovery only pending official feed/API review. Containment or reported acreage does not equal physical damage polygon or insured loss.

entries.name: Copernicus Sentinel-5P TROPOMI Level-2 NO2 columns
entries.spatial_scope: global with cloud/algorithm coverage constraints
entries.temporal_scope: 2018-present archives; separate near-real-time and non-time-critical processing
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Tropospheric nitrogen dioxide column products, product QA and L2 pixels or openEO/Sentinel Hub aggregation
entries.note: World Monitor uses Sentinel-5P TROPOMI NO2 as an industrial activity proxy. This is distinct from the existing Sentinel-5P SO2 volcano entry. September 2026 CDSE openEO adds collection SENTINEL5P_L2_NO2. NO2 reflects emissions, weather, chemistry, seasonality and clouds; it is never direct site production, asset damage or insured loss.

entries.name: FloodScan near-real-time and historical flood mapping
entries.spatial_scope: global coverage stated in WFP ADAM, product-specific
entries.temporal_scope: near-real-time and historical flood estimates; precise span/version to be checked
entries.resolution_or_granularity: flood extent / surface-water presence layers and associated quality/processing metadata
entries.note: WFP ADAM documents FloodScan as a flood observatory upstream. Whether OpenCatastrophe can obtain the exact FloodScan product commercially or redistribute results is unknown; fail closed. ADAM-derived features reuse FloodScan and cannot serve as independent holdout against original FloodScan.
